description:
## Background

Graph now exists as an Issue Navigation destination, but the successful Graph shell does not yet visualize relationships. The first canvas slice should prove the chosen React card and parent-layout approach without also taking on blocker routing, dense Show-all behavior, or Issue Detail.

The existing `allIssues` snapshot is sufficient. Current Work means every Issue whose stored status is not `closed`; this is intentionally different from Beadwork's Ready and Blocked views.

Triage: ready-for-agent.

## What to build

Render a useful Focused graph of Current Work and direct parent context. Users can see fixed Issue cards arranged in a deterministic top-to-bottom parent hierarchy and navigate the canvas with pan, zoom, and fit controls.

## Technical Approach

- Add `@xyflow/react` and `@dagrejs/dagre` as renderer dependencies.
- Introduce one graph module whose caller supplies `allIssues`, Focused scope, and the optional selected Issue ID and receives render-ready cards and typed parent links.
- Seed Focused with every non-closed Issue plus the selected Issue when one exists.
- Add only each seed's direct parent in this slice, including a closed parent when present in `allIssues`.
- Treat the explicit `parent` field as authoritative; never infer parentage from dotted Issue IDs.
- Build deterministic card/link ordering for identical snapshots.
- Lay out cards from parent → child links with Dagre in a top-to-bottom direction.
- Render React Flow as a browser: fixed nodes, no connecting or deletion, canvas drag to pan, zoom and fit controls, and retained attribution.
- Cards show Issue ID and title and expose enough accessible text to identify status and parent context.
- Clearly label the graph as Focused and show visible/total Issue counts so it cannot be mistaken for the full Workspace.

## Considerations

- Do not add blocker context or blocker edges; that is the next child.
- Do not add Show all, Issue Detail, manual arrangement, graph search, or viewport persistence.
- React Flow's `parentId` means visual containment and must not represent Beadwork parentage.
- A selected closed Issue inherited from List is a seed even though card activation is not implemented yet.
- An empty Workspace and a Focused graph with no seeds are different: the latter may still offer future Show-all behavior, but this slice should present accurate focused-empty copy.
- No Rust, TauRPC, Git read, or Beadwork CLI change belongs here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Focused contains every non-closed Issue, the optional selected Issue, and each seed's direct parent exactly once.
- [ ] Parent links come only from explicit `parent` values whose endpoints are visible.
- [ ] Cards show Issue ID and title in a deterministic top-to-bottom parent layout.
- [ ] Cards cannot be moved or connected; dragging empty canvas space pans.
- [ ] Keyboard users can focus visible cards and operate zoom/fit controls.
- [ ] Focused scope and visible/total counts make the partial view explicit.
- [ ] Empty and focused-empty states are accurate.
- [ ] Existing List mode and Issue Explorer loading/failure behavior remain unchanged.
- [ ] `mise run doctor:react` and `mise run verify` pass.

## Test Plan

- Pure graph-module fixtures for non-closed seeds, a selected closed seed, direct parents, roots, multiple trees, and deterministic output.
- Component tests for card content, Focused labeling/counts, fixed-node configuration, canvas controls, attribution, and keyboard focus.
- App integration coverage proving Graph renders from the existing successful Issue Explorer snapshot without another load.
- Run the canonical `mise run verify` gate.
title: Browse the Focused parent hierarchy
